summary: Engine-generated vectors now keep every origin period instead of blanking the rows after the Development End Date.
details: A monthly vector in an August project keeps its full-year input values in the last four rows rather than showing zeros.
Triangles still stop at the latest valuation diagonal.
A negative row index in a DFM formula or an ArcRho dataset link, such as [Premium][-1], still lands on the valuation period even when later rows of the vector hold values.
